newsitem.title: ITALY: Reuters Asset Allocation Poll (Italy) - December 11.
newsitem.headline: Reuters Asset Allocation Poll (Italy) - December 11.

text.p: Italian banks and fund managers favour domestic bonds or foreign assets and debt rather than the Italian equities market, an Italian Reuters Asset Allocation Poll showed on Wednesday.
In its first monthly poll Reuters contacted major Italian banks and fund managers. The next poll will be researched and published in mid-January.

Analysts said the Italian stock market did not adequately reflect the real situation in the Italian economy and the ratio between risk and yields favoured investment in the bond market rather than equities.
However banks and fund managers polled said Italian markets had proved very attractive in the past year, with a sustained rally in the bond market, which meant further market gains were less likely.

In addition to this, analysts noted the new year could bring fresh political turmoil. Any signs of instability in Prime Minister Romano Prodi's government would endanger gains made by Italian markets this year, they said.
The Italian equities section of the poll is based on the Morgan Stanley Company Index. Emerging markets include the Latam countries, the South Pacific and the former Soviet bloc.
